scope.note: Root records at or after the follow-up request are excluded. The root file hash reflects the file at extraction time, including the excluded follow-up.

unknowns: The Agent tool call input carries no effort field; the effective effort per subagent is observed in transcripts only, not specified by the caller.
The configured model of the maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner definition is not recorded in the session files; only the observed model is.
The subagent meta files do not record a model field; requestedModel in transcripts is the only model request evidence.
The API request IDs, account and organization metadata, environment and credential values are intentionally excluded.
Thinking blocks and signatures are excluded; only the type of each content block is recorded.
Spawn depth is taken from the meta files as recorded; the root session is depth 0 by inference.
Whether the root session itself used a planner-equivalent model is recorded only as observed root models; no subagent-to-root mapping beyond toolUseId is confirmed.
